attack_validity.meaning: the attack must relearn the prompts it was TRAINED on; if T does not rise, a flat H is not evidence of robustness

grad_and_delta_evidence.note: text_encoder_grad_norm_step0 is 0.0 for UNet-only attacks BY DESIGN. Before the ISSUE-2 repair it was also 0 with --attack-te set, because embeddings were cached under no_grad; those historical joint-attack labels were UNet-only in fact.

trainability.meaning: fraction of the loss on the attacker's OWN data that the attacker could remove, on a frozen fixed-noise probe. Same statistic as the MDLM phase's FINDING33, so the two phases are comparable; the audit flagged that they were not.

recovery.scope_warning: H_after is TARGET REGENERATION on held-out prompts only. H_after = 1.000 means the classifier recognised the target in all 15 evaluated images; it does NOT mean the base model was restored. Read post_attack_utility for what else survived.

post_attack_utility.paired: identical generator seeds before and after; the two panels differ only by the attacked weights

general_image_quality.why: FID on 48 images is not a defensible estimate. prompt_adherence is reported instead as a per-image proxy, and the protocol that would make an FID number meaningful here is written up but NOT yet run.

post_attack_utility.three_axes: target regeneration = recovery.H_after; retained capability = retained_capability; general image quality = prompt_adherence now, FID pending. These are distinct and were conflated before this repair.
